{{Top|leg}}
'''Armin speeders''' were a type of [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] in use on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="Deceived">''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]''</ref> in [[3653 BBY]].<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]'' to [[3653 BBY]].</ref> During the [[Sacking of Coruscant]], [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Zeerid Korr]] came across an abandoned Armin speeder in the middle of a street on Coruscant. With Coruscant in ruins and many vehicles left behind, Korr took the speeder to help him and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Aryn Leneer]] travel around the devastated [[City/Legends|city]]. Later, during a [[Duel in the ruins of the Jedi Temple|confrontation]] between Aryn Leneer and [[Darth Malgus]], Korr piloted the Armin speeder into the ruins of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] to extract her.<ref name="Deceived" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Armin speeder first appeared in the [[2011]] novel ''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]'', written by [[Paul S. Kemp]].<ref name="Deceived" />
